content.title: The International Seerah-un-Nabi Book Fair 2026 Is Underway at Baitul Mukarram’s East Gate
content.subtitle: When are you coming with your family?
content.body:
Once, we had an intense thirst for books. We would hide storybooks and novels behind our textbooks, stay up late turning pages, and find joy in the scent of new books. Those moments quietly shaped our thoughts and the person within us. But today? We are trapped in a strange spell beneath the blue glow of rectangular screens. We have drifted far away from books and, without realizing it, placed lifeless screens in our children’s hands. At the very age when their hearts should be discovering the light of books, many are instead getting lost in an artificial fascination.

Helping the Next Generation Discover Their True Heroes

To make a nation spiritually empty, it is enough to make it forget its roots and glorious history. Think about it: who do our children know as heroes today? Spider-Man, Batman, cartoon characters, and video game figures with no real existence, who can neither teach them lasting ideals nor show them a meaningful path in life. Yet they should know the true heroes of Islam: the courage of Khalid ibn al-Walid, the justice of Umar ibn al-Khattab, the remarkable bravery of Ali (RA), and above all, the unparalleled life of our beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. If we do not introduce them to these true heroes today, where will they search for their identity tomorrow?

An International Treasure House of Priceless Knowledge

To nourish those spiritually dry hearts, the International Seerah-un-Nabi Book Fair 2026 has come alive at the Baitul Mukarram premises for an entire month. Alongside renowned publishers from Bangladesh, the fair features publications from around the world. From classical Arabic works and scholarly research to thoughtful Seerah books, contemporary Islamic literature, novels, heartfelt biographies of the Companions, and essential books on faith and character, a vast ocean of knowledge has gathered in this one place.

A Colorful Islamic Learning Space for Little Hearts

To engage young minds, the fair offers a beautiful collection of Islamic books, including the Akhlaq Series for character building, the Asmaul Husna Series to learn about the beautiful names of Allah, and age-appropriate literature for children and teenagers.

In this age of widespread trials and distractions, sound Islamic knowledge is one of the greatest shields we can give our children. If we do not enrich them with the light of true knowledge, the currents of society and the virtual world can easily carry their faith away. We must build them on foundations strong enough to withstand confusion, so they can become beacons of light in an age of darkness and pass the timeless torch of truth, beauty, and faith to the next generation.

When, Where, and How to Visit

This blessed celebration of knowledge began on September 10 and will continue for an entire month.

  • Venue: East Gate premises of Baitul Mukarram National Mosque

  • Opening Hours: Every day, 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM; holidays, 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

Life passes while we remain busy making excuses. But opportunities to awaken a child’s thirst for knowledge do not come every day. So bring your family, hold your children’s hands, and step into this blessed world of books. Will you be there?
